assumptions: Zero or unreported composition values use frozen nondetection replacement before logratio analysis; they are not confirmed structural zeros.
Artifact, not sampling point or repeated fold, is the independent grouping unit.
The deterministic internal train/validation/test groups are exposed Development groups; no split restores blind status and no formal Final evaluator is used.
Known classification CV excludes old internal test groups; all-known descriptive analysis remains contaminated Development evidence.
Sampling point CLR centers are first averaged within artifact, then artifacts receive equal weight.
Backcasts assume type exchangeability and estimated weathering shifts; two paired artifacts do not identify causal alteration or original composition truth.
Subclasses and bootstrap association differences are exploratory, with fixed k/features per stability analysis and no multiplicity or coverage guarantees.
Composition perturbations add Gaussian noise of 0.01 simplex units, then floor and reclose; this is not 1 percent relative multiplicative noise.
Decision scores and neighbor votes are uncalibrated; unknown sample labels are missing, so distance applicability and flip stability cannot establish predictive accuracy.
Frozen budgets: 2 CV repeats, 999 permutations, 20 subtype bootstrap, 30 association bootstrap, 50 perturbations per unknown sample.
